study: Validation-only matched intervention replay: A-MARL-derived IPPO SPT vs carbon-aware latency-bounded SPT

method.checkpoint_source: existing proposed_epsilon_0 checkpoints from research_alignment_v1, one checkpoint per policy seed reused unchanged across all conditions
method.same_conditions: same validation family/seed workload, dynamic synthetic 512-slot carbon profile, environment parameters, policy checkpoint, entropy threshold, intervention probability and stochastic action seed within each matched pair
method.inference: stochastic policy actions enabled; SPT entropy trigger active; no optimizer updates
method.base_rule: existing IPPOScheduler._spt_destination: minimum execution time among feasible destinations; this is the repository's cloud mapping of shortest processing time
method.proposed_rule: minimum total migration plus execution latency among feasible destinations, then minimum estimated carbon among candidates within allowance
method.actual_emissions_definition: episode totals are final integrated region emissions from simulator assignments; each placement candidate carbon is a pre-assignment marginal estimate, not a separately measured realized task emission
